articles.title: After a Year of Blistering Growth, AI Chip Makers Get Ready for Bigger 2026
articles.mainIdea: After a Year of Blistering Growth, AI Chip Makers Get Ready for Bigger 2026
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: After a Year of Blistering Growth, AI Chip Makers Get Ready for Bigger 2026. Driven by the explosive growth of artificial intelligence, the largest semiconductor companies in the world recorded more than $400 billion in combined sales in 2025, by far the biggest year for chips on record. Hardware designers such as Nvidia which more than doubled its revenue year-over-year, are the main suppliers of the picks and shovels behind this new digital gold rush. Related tickers mentioned: AMZN, GOOG, NVDA.
